items.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021
items.q: The transcript only shows Monk Rowe introducing himself as the interviewer and Harold Danko thanking him. No personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context is described.

ctx.x: Harold was interviewed via Zoom on April 28, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m pleased to have Harold Danko with me today, who is a pianist, composer, and professor emeritus at Eastman School of Music. And I probably left some things out but maybe we’ll get to that.
